description: This Java source file defines the MethodContext class, which acts as a container for the state of the Mini-language script engine within the OFBiz framework. It manages environment variables, request/response objects, parameters, results, and context-related data such as locale, timezone, security, and user login information. Several constructors allow initialization from different contexts like HTTP requests or service dispatch contexts. The class provides methods to access, modify, and remove environment and parameter data, facilitating the execution and management of Mini-language scripts within the framework.

classes.name: MethodContext
classes.description: A container for the Mini-language script engine state, managing environment variables, request/response data, parameters, results, locale, timezone, security, and user login info. Supports construction from service or event contexts and provides methods to manipulate and access the encapsulated data.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance associated with this context.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Returns the LocalDispatcher instance associated with this context.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the environment map using a FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Retrieves an environment value by key, supports expansion with ${} syntax.

methods.name: getEnvMap
methods.description: Returns the entire environment map.

methods.name: getLoader
methods.description: Returns the ClassLoader used in this context.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the Locale associated with this context.

methods.name: getMethodType
methods.description: Returns the type of method (EVENT or SERVICE) this context represents.

methods.name: getParameter
methods.description: Retrieves a parameter value by key.

methods.name: getParameters

methods.name: getRequest

methods.name: getResult

methods.name: getResults

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Returns the Security object associated with this context.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the TimeZone associated with this context.

methods.name: getTraceLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the current trace log level.

methods.name: getUserLogin
methods.description: Returns the user login information (GenericValue).

methods.name: isTraceOn

methods.description: Adds multiple entries to the environment map.

methods.name: putEnv
methods.description: Puts a value into the environment map using a FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: putEnv
methods.description: Sets a named environment value, supporting expansion syntax.

methods.name: putParameter
methods.description: Adds a parameter to the parameters map.

methods.name: putResult
methods.description: Adds a result to the results map.

methods.name: removeEnv
methods.description: Removes a value from the environment map using a FlexibleMapAccessor.

methods.name: removeEnv
methods.description: Removes a named environment value, supporting expansion syntax.

methods.name: setTraceOn
